p2_04_authorization_slice.root_cause: internal/source.service.go authorizeAdmin and three other copies read platform.role_bindings by subject while native sessions project identity.role_grants; a native administrator therefore had no legacy row and every admin transaction answered 403
p2_04_authorization_slice.fix: new internal/authz package is the single shared check; native sessions are proven only by identity.authorize_native_role (migration 47/48) at the session authorization version with FOR SHARE, legacy sessions only by platform.role_bindings; neither source can fall back to the other
